prompts.materials: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single 2x2 building material atlas. Style reference: the supplied approved scene concept, muted warm grey-green prison, hand-painted outlined cartoon game architecture, gentle wear and low-frequency mottling, not pixel art, not photorealistic. Deliver clean production texture art, no text labels/watermark/characters/UI. Image 1 is a style reference only. New image should be exactly square, preferably 1536x1536, full edge-to-edge opaque FOUR equally sized square material patches with a perfectly straight vertical and horizontal divider at image center. No gap, border, frame or label between patches. TOP LEFT: roof top surface made of large dark charcoal grey-green flat weathered stone/concrete slabs, scattered subtle abrasion and narrow irregular hairline mortar, opaque solid roof, no voids. TOP RIGHT: dark grey-green prison wall front with restrained large rectangular masonry courses, mostly broad face, no top face. BOTTOM LEFT: dark stone coping top surface, broad rectangular blocks and subdued joints, slightly lighter than roof. BOTTOM RIGHT: pale warm-grey plaster cafeteria wall front, gently weathered, large quiet plaster panels above one darker grey-green low masonry plinth; narrow warm cream horizontal separator above plinth. Each square is a completely flat orthographic 2D material sample, no extrusion, perspective, edge bevel on outside perimeter, cast shadow, fake lighting falloff, surrounding background or objects. Patches are filled completely opaque to their exact square edges. Materials should be visually repeatable horizontally with compatible left/right color and courses, roof and coping also vertically repeatable with quiet edges; no uniquely large hero crack. Match reference colors and brushwork.
prompts.solitary: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas, TWO STATE cells. Style reference: the supplied approved scene concept, muted warm grey-green prison, hand-painted outlined cartoon game architecture, gentle wear and low-frequency mottling, not pixel art, not photorealistic. Deliver clean production texture art, no text labels/watermark/characters/UI. Image 1 is a style reference only, focus on the approved solitary exterior iron door. Make a wide landscape image containing TWO exactly equal-size rectangular cells side by side, left CLOSED door, right OPEN door. Each cell aspect ratio about 160:110, both cells identical canvas/scale, very small transparent edge padding; common threshold baseline at 92% cell height. A SINGLE wide dark steel plate door, steel grey with muted blue-grey edges, small rivets, tiny closed observation hatch upper center, subdued brass lock right. NO surrounding masonry or giant freestanding frame; only narrow metal jamb strips flush on left/right and thin threshold track that can be recessed in supplied stone wall. Gentle elevated orthographic view: front face dominant, very shallow top and side depth, axis-aligned vertical uprights and horizontal door top, no isometric rotation. LEFT CLOSED: broad steel door fills doorway. RIGHT OPEN: same door swung fully inward toward the LEFT, nearly edge-on against left jamb, narrow blade of steel approx 12% of doorway width with subtle visible hinges; whole remaining doorway truly transparent alpha, no black room, wall, stone, floor or shadow painted inside the opening. Fixed jambs/threshold have identical positions, same width/height and baseline in the two cells. Anchor and cell outer extents unchanged. Outer background fully transparent, no checkerboard baked, no cast ground shadow. No floor/tile/base slab. Do not shrink the open state to the leaf bounds; show same full cell occupied by transparent opening. This wide door is mounted inside a high masonry wall by renderer.
